text_block_list.name: Misty★Kasumi
text_block_list.text:
I never once thought I'd become a magical girl...
I can't let anyone in the guild see me like this...
choice_data_list: Kaori would probably try to copy you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか、
魔法少女になっちゃうなんて……
この姿は、
ギルドのみんなには見せられないよ……

text_block_list.name: Misty★Kasumi
text_block_list.text:
...I can already envision her response: \"Kasumi's makin' her Maho-Maho
Kingdom debut! ♪\" she would say, while forcing me to try on lots of
different clothes. Ugh... Spare me the cute attire—I've had enough...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……推理するまでもなく
『カスミはんも
マホマホ王国デビューどす～♪』
とか言いながら、
色んな服を着せてくるのが目に浮かぶよ。
うう……
もうかわいい系の服は勘弁してくれ……

text_block_list.name: Misty★Kasumi
text_block_list.text:
It's true that a magical girl's main job is to patrol the city, so she's the
most likely to understand! Maybe I'll go and ask Mora to turn her into
Magical Guard Dog★Wolven Makoto!
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに、
魔法少女の活動は基本、
町のパトロールなわけだし、
一番理解があるかも！　
今すぐモーラくんに言って、
魔法番狼★ウルフェンマコト
になってもらおう！

text_block_list.name: Misty★Kasumi
text_block_list.text:
...She'd incorporate my transformation pose into her dancing, and say
\"Look at me, I'm Kasumi! ♪\" or something like that, and dance half-naked
from morning until night. Listen, she's the one person we must not tell!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……踊りにあの変身ポーズを取り入れて、
『カスミの真似さ～♪』
とか
言いながら、
朝も昼も夜も半裸で踊り明かすだろうね。
よし、
あの人にだけは、
絶対バレないようにしよう！
